maddeler.e:
أستتبع (form X)
# أَسْتَتْبِعُ (ʔastatbiʕu) /ʔas.tat.bi.ʕu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَتْبَعَ (istatbaʕa)
# أَسْتَتْبِعَ (ʔastatbiʕa) /ʔas.tat.bi.ʕa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَتْبَعَ (istatbaʕa)
# أَسْتَتْبِعْ (ʔastatbiʕ) /ʔas.tat.biʕ/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِسْتَتْبَعَ (istatbaʕa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
